description: Resumen general de ventas, envíos, sobrantes, gastos y devoluciones de las tiendas.

panels.description: Suma de las ventas SIN aplicar descuento y sin incluir el envío.

targets.rawSql:
-- Resumen general: UNA fila con los indicadores de las tiendas del filtro
-- Tienda, dentro del rango de tiempo del dashboard.
-- Esta consulta alimenta los 10 KPI: este panel la ejecuta y los demas la
-- leen con el datasource "-- Dashboard --" (una sola ida a la base).
-- Cada CTE agrega sin GROUP BY, asi que siempre devuelve una fila (en cero si
-- no hubo movimiento).
WITH ventas AS (
    SELECT
        count(*)                                                     AS ventas,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss.delivery > 0)                      AS envios,
        -- bruto de producto: antes de descuento y sin envio (= sum(shop_sale_element.subtotal))
        sum(ss.total - COALESCE(ss.delivery, 0) + ss.total_discount) AS total_ventas,
        sum(COALESCE(ss.delivery, 0))                                AS total_envios
    FROM shop_sale ss
    WHERE ss.status_id = 52                                   -- solo ventas activas (54 = cancelada)
      AND ss.establishment_id::text IN (${tienda:sqlstring})
      AND $__timeFilter(ss.creation_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
),
sobrantes AS (
    SELECT
        count(*)                   AS sobrantes,
        sum(cc.sobrante)           AS total_sobrante
    FROM cash_closing cc
    WHERE cc.sobrante > 0                                     -- cierres con sobrante capturado
      AND cc.establishment_id::text IN (${tienda:sqlstring})
      AND $__timeFilter(cc.creation_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
),
gastos AS (
    SELECT
        count(*)                   AS gastos,
        sum(se.total_amount)       AS total_gastos
    FROM store_expense se
    WHERE se.status_id = 58                                   -- gasto activo (59 = eliminado)
      AND se.establishment_id::text IN (${tienda:sqlstring})
      AND $__timeFilter(se.creation_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
),
devoluciones AS (
    SELECT
        count(*)                       AS devoluciones,
        -- cantidad (ya en unidad base) * precio VIGENTE por unidad base: mismo
        -- criterio que el cierre de caja. No hay historico de precio.
        sum(iea.quantity * pfs.price)  AS total_devoluciones
    FROM inventory_element_action iea
    JOIN inventory_element ie  ON ie.id  = iea.source_inventory_element_id
    JOIN inventory         i   ON i.id   = ie.inventory_id
    JOIN product_for_sale  pfs ON pfs.id = ie.element_fk
    WHERE iea.action_type_id = 17                             -- remove_pfs_by_devolution
      AND i.inventory_type = 'product_for_sale'
      AND i.unit_name IN (${tienda:sqlstring})                -- unit_name = uuid de la tienda (texto)
      AND $__timeFilter(iea.creation_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(v.ventas, 0)                       AS "Ventas",
    COALESCE(v.envios, 0)                       AS "Envios",
    COALESCE(s.sobrantes, 0)                    AS "Sobrante",
    COALESCE(g.gastos, 0)                       AS "Gastos",
    COALESCE(d.devoluciones, 0)                 AS "Devoluciones",
    round(COALESCE(v.total_ventas, 0), 2)       AS "Total ventas",
    round(COALESCE(v.total_envios, 0), 2)       AS "Total envios",
    round(COALESCE(s.total_sobrante, 0), 2)     AS "Total sobrante",
    round(COALESCE(g.total_gastos, 0), 2)       AS "Total gastos",
    round(COALESCE(d.total_devoluciones, 0), 2) AS "Total devoluciones"
FROM ventas v
CROSS JOIN sobrantes s
CROSS JOIN gastos g
CROSS JOIN devoluciones d;

panels.description: Total de ventas activas por periodo, **sin descuento ni envío**. El tamaño del periodo se cambia en **Agrupar por**; los periodos sin ventas se muestran en 0.

targets.rawSql:
-- Total ventas por periodo (dia / semana / mes segun el filtro "Agrupar por").
WITH periodos AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        date_trunc('${agrupacion}', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'America/Guatemala'),
        LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Guatemala',
        '1 ${agrupacion}'::interval
    ) AS periodo
),
datos AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('${agrupacion}', ss.creation_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Guatemala') AS periodo,
        sum(ss.total - COALESCE(ss.delivery, 0) + ss.total_discount) AS total
    FROM shop_sale ss
    WHERE ss.status_id = 52                                  -- solo ventas activas (54 = cancelada)
      AND ss.establishment_id::text IN (${tienda:sqlstring})
      AND $__timeFilter(ss.creation_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    p.periodo AT TIME ZONE 'America/Guatemala'   AS "time",
    round(COALESCE(d.total, 0), 2)   AS "Total ventas"
FROM periodos p
LEFT JOIN datos d ON d.periodo = p.periodo
ORDER BY 1;

panels.description:
Indicadores de las tiendas seleccionadas en **Tienda**, dentro del rango de tiempo del dashboard. Una fila por tienda; la fila de totales coincide con los KPI.

- **Ventas / Total ventas**: ventas activas; el total es antes de descuento y sin envío.
- **Envios / Total envios**: ventas con costo de envío y la suma de ese costo.
- **Sobrante / Total sobrante**: cierres de caja con sobrante capturado.
- **Gastos / Total gastos**: gastos de tienda activos.
- **Devoluciones / Total devoluciones**: producto devuelto de tienda a bodega. El total usa el precio vigente del producto (*pendiente de revisar*).

-- Mismo resumen desglosado: una fila por tienda del filtro Tienda.
-- Las tiendas sin movimiento en el periodo aparecen en cero.
-- La fila de totales la calcula Grafana (footer), y coincide con los KPI.
WITH tiendas AS (
    SELECT e.id::text AS id, e."name"
    FROM establishment e
    WHERE e.id::text IN (${tienda:sqlstring})
),
ventas AS (
    SELECT
        ss.establishment_id::text                                    AS tienda_id,
        count(*)                                                     AS ventas,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss.delivery > 0)                      AS envios,
        -- bruto de producto: antes de descuento y sin envio (= sum(shop_sale_element.subtotal))
        sum(ss.total - COALESCE(ss.delivery, 0) + ss.total_discount) AS total_ventas,
        sum(COALESCE(ss.delivery, 0))                                AS total_envios
    FROM shop_sale ss
    WHERE ss.status_id = 52                                   -- solo ventas activas (54 = cancelada)
      AND ss.establishment_id::text IN (${tienda:sqlstring})
      AND $__timeFilter(ss.creation_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    GROUP BY ss.establishment_id
),
sobrantes AS (
    SELECT
        cc.establishment_id::text  AS tienda_id,
        count(*)                   AS sobrantes,
        sum(cc.sobrante)           AS total_sobrante
    FROM cash_closing cc
    WHERE cc.sobrante > 0                                     -- cierres con sobrante capturado
      AND cc.establishment_id::text IN (${tienda:sqlstring})
      AND $__timeFilter(cc.creation_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    GROUP BY cc.establishment_id
),
gastos AS (
    SELECT
        se.establishment_id::text  AS tienda_id,
        count(*)                   AS gastos,
        sum(se.total_amount)       AS total_gastos
    FROM store_expense se
    WHERE se.status_id = 58                                   -- gasto activo (59 = eliminado)
      AND se.establishment_id::text IN (${tienda:sqlstring})
      AND $__timeFilter(se.creation_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    GROUP BY se.establishment_id
),
devoluciones AS (
    SELECT
        i.unit_name                    AS tienda_id,
        count(*)                       AS devoluciones,
        -- cantidad (ya en unidad base) * precio VIGENTE por unidad base: mismo
        -- criterio que el cierre de caja. No hay historico de precio.
        sum(iea.quantity * pfs.price)  AS total_devoluciones
    FROM inventory_element_action iea
    JOIN inventory_element ie  ON ie.id  = iea.source_inventory_element_id
    JOIN inventory         i   ON i.id   = ie.inventory_id
    JOIN product_for_sale  pfs ON pfs.id = ie.element_fk
    WHERE iea.action_type_id = 17                             -- remove_pfs_by_devolution
      AND i.inventory_type = 'product_for_sale'
      AND i.unit_name IN (${tienda:sqlstring})                -- unit_name = uuid de la tienda (texto)
      AND $__timeFilter(iea.creation_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    GROUP BY i.unit_name
)
SELECT
    t."name"                                    AS "Tienda",
    COALESCE(v.ventas, 0)                       AS "Ventas",
    COALESCE(v.envios, 0)                       AS "Envios",
    COALESCE(s.sobrantes, 0)                    AS "Sobrante",
    COALESCE(g.gastos, 0)                       AS "Gastos",
    COALESCE(d.devoluciones, 0)                 AS "Devoluciones",
    round(COALESCE(v.total_ventas, 0), 2)       AS "Total ventas",
    round(COALESCE(v.total_envios, 0), 2)       AS "Total envios",
    round(COALESCE(s.total_sobrante, 0), 2)     AS "Total sobrante",
    round(COALESCE(g.total_gastos, 0), 2)       AS "Total gastos",
    round(COALESCE(d.total_devoluciones, 0), 2) AS "Total devoluciones"
FROM tiendas t
LEFT JOIN ventas       v ON v.tienda_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN sobrantes    s ON s.tienda_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN gastos       g ON g.tienda_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN devoluciones d ON d.tienda_id = t.id
ORDER BY t."name";
